dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle tip.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Largely smooth lateral margins with a slight localized indentation on the left mid-lateral edge.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, light-grey linear marks running longitudinally across the mid-dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed linear rake marks visible across the dorsal plane.
